data.body: [P1] This stage erases every handler cleanup failure. If suspension or retry has already completed `executionFuture`, a scope close that `PluginRunner` deliberately rethrows as `ThreadDeath` or `VirtualMachineError` is still followed by PENDING/RETRYING, leaving the fatal error unobserved. Capture the handler error, rethrow any unwrapped fatal before returning the winning future, define equivalent handling after a timeout, and add execute-level suspension/retry tests with fatal scope cleanup.
